title: SEG Requirement Node
description: Schema for a Requirement node in the Safety Evidence Graph. Maps to spdx:Requirement on SPDX export. Sourced from repo A (sphinx-needs .rst files). Authored by the Requirements Engineer. Node hashes are computed transiently by the extractor and persisted only in sealed proof documents — not stored in this record.

id.description: Globally unique IRI for this requirement. Form: {namespaceBase}/req/REQ-{number}. Maps to spdxId on SPDX export.

type.description: Fixed SEG type. Maps to spdx:Requirement on SPDX export.

name.description: Human-readable requirement identifier. Must match the ID suffix in the id field.

description.description: The full requirement text body as authored in sphinx-needs.

seg:sourceRepo.description: Source repository for this node. Fixed to repoA for all Requirement nodes. Resolves to the concrete repo URL defined in config.json.

seg:sourcePath.description: Relative path within repo A to the .rst file containing this requirement.

comment.description: Optional free-text note. Not part of the node content and not included in nodeHash computation.
